title: Behavioral Industrial Organization
abstract: FLAG: This is a Handbook chapter (Heidhues & Kőszegi, 'Behavioral Industrial Organization' in Handbook of Behavioral Economics, vol. 1, eds. Bernheim, DellaVigna, Laibson; Elsevier North-Holland, 2018, pp. 517-612, DOI 10.1016/bs.hesbe.2018.07.006). The chapter reviews research on how rational profit-maximizing firms respond to richer and more realistic types of consumer preferences identified in the behavioral-economics literature, contrasted with classical industrial organization where consumer preferences are extremely simple. [Source: publisher / CEPR DP description; verify against published handbook abstract.]
